translations.web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
translations.bsb: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
translations.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
translations.asv: He hath showed strength with his arm; He hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their heart.
